column1: # FairytaleQA-type questions for three Aesop fables (Project Gutenberg #21, public domain).
# Columns (TAB): doc, id, type, question, state query (qa.rs), expected (groups separated by commas — all; steps
# separated by > — in order; alternatives separated by | — any). Written before the LLM call, not edited after it.

column4: Who are the main characters of the fable?
Where was the Crow when the Fox praised her?
Who had the meat (not cheese in this translation) at the beginning and at the end?
Why did the Fox praise the Crow?
column5: say char:fox to=char:crow || why agent=char:fox verb=praise|flatter

column4: What did the Crow feel when the Fox doubted her voice?
Why did the Crow caw?
What happened to the meat when the Crow cawed?
Will the Crow trust the Fox from now on?
Who woke the Lion?
column5: cause char:lion sleep=awake || who verb=wake|awaken|rouse|disturb patient=char:lion

column4: What did the Lion feel when he caught the Mouse?
What did the Mouse promise the Lion?
Why did the Lion let the Mouse go?
column5: why agent=char:lion verb=release|free|let_go|spare|let|laugh || cause char:mouse freedom=free

column4: Who tied up the Lion?
How did the Mouse free the Lion?
How did the relationship between the Lion and the Mouse change?
What will happen if the Lion meets the Mouse again?
Who chose the course and the goal of the race?
column5: who verb=choose|fix|select|set|mark|judge|appoint|decide || attr char:fox status @last || attr char:fox goal @last

column4: Why did the Hare agree to the race?
column5: attr char:hare belief ^s2 || why agent=char:hare verb=agree|accept|assent|consent || say char:hare act=agree

column4: Where did the Hare fall asleep?
What was the Tortoise doing during the race?
Who won the race?
column5: who verb=win|beat || cause char:tortoise status=winner || who verb=reach|finish|arrive

column4: What did the Tortoise feel at the end?
Why did the Hare lose?
column5: why agent=char:hare verb=sleep|lie|fall_asleep|nap|rest|lie_down|doze || events agent=char:hare from=^s5 to=^s5 || attr char:hare sleep ^s5

column4: Why did the slow Tortoise win (the moral)?
